why: A red admin harness, RLS or RPC run should block a merge, and today none of them does.

title: Confirm live definer functions pin search_path
why: The harness proves the migrations, not hand edits on the live project.
how: Paste the read-only query from the Commands run section
Check no `public` row has a null path, `$user` or a client-writable schema
Note the count next to the harness's 120

title: Check the strict style-src on the preview deploy
why: The CSP without 'unsafe-inline' only proves itself on the real Pages host and real Safari.
where: grep -i content-security-policy` and confirm style-src reads `'self'` plus two sha256 hashes and no 'unsafe-inline'; open the preview in Chrome with DevTools Console open, walk the map, a destination, a trail and the trip planner, and confirm no "Refused to apply inline style" line; open a prerendered page (any /spain/trails/... link from the sitemap) and confirm the reading column is styled and the console is clean, and if it is not, re-run the prerender upload (`node scripts/prerender/build.mjs` then `push.mjs`) so the pages carry the current STYLE; print a saved trip and confirm the print view is styled; repeat the trail and print checks on an iPhone in Safari
how: After the next deploy to the preview branch, run `curl -sI https://preview.carta-app.pages.dev/

title: Rebuild the trails wire with the new names and per-day difficulty
why: The code is merged, but the shipped wire still has 2,865 very-hard rows (Veluwe Zwerfpad among them) and 643 Cyrillic or Greek names until the lab reruns.
how: On the box with trailslab up (cd tools/trailslab && docker compose up -d)
Check NL.json id 114362 has f.g moderate and f.d 14
Push data with the next deploy (node scripts/r2/push-data.mjs --live)

title: Look at the trail card and trail page on a real phone after the rebuild
why: The browser check could not run in the cloud container (data host blocked).
how: Open Explore, Trails, Netherlands, find Veluwe Zwerfpad: the card says Long, the page grade fact says Long, 14 days
Open an E-path stage in Andorra or Poland: the title reads E7, Andorra (or E3, Poland (west)) with Also called and the full name under it
